meta.name: meme
meta.description:
Generate meme images by overlaying text onto templates.
Zero barrier — works with Python + Pillow, no framework needed.
Templates are fetched on demand from the awesome-meme data repo.
Use for "meme", "meme generator", "text overlay", "distracted boyfriend", "image macro".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在模板上叠加文字生成表情包图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速制作搞笑表情包分享给朋友或同事。
copy.tagline_en: Generate meme images by overlaying text onto templates.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly create funny memes to share with friends or colleagues.

howto.what: Claude 可以根据你提供的文字和模板名称，生成一张带文字的梗图图片。它支持 30 多种模板，自动下载模板并叠加文字。
howto.when: 当你提到“meme”、“梗图”、“文字叠加”等关键词，或者要求生成特定模板（如“分心男友”）的梗图时触发。

say.text: 生成一张“分心男友”梗图，左边写“ZIG”，右边写“ME”，中间写“RUST”。
say.note: 会生成对应模板的梗图。

howto.what_en: Claude can generate a meme image by overlaying your text onto a template. It supports 30+ templates, auto-downloading them from GitHub.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'meme', 'meme generator', 'text overlay', or request a specific template like 'distracted boyfriend'.

say_en.note: Creates the meme with that template.

say_en.text: Use 'this is fine' template, top text 'ERROR LOG', bottom 'THIS IS FINE'.
say_en.note: Creates the meme with that template.
